title: Human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) virus – update
summary: 17 May 2013 -- Since 8 May 2013, no new laboratory-confirmed cases of human infection with avian influenza A(H7N9) have been reported to WHO by the National Health and Family Planning Commission, China.  However, four additional deaths have been reported from previously laboratory-confirmed cases.
